BiblicalUsage: Hashma'uth is an announcement, a report brought to the ear, and it appears once. In Ezekiel 24:26 God tells Ezekiel that the day the city falls, a fugitive shall come to cause him to hear the news with his own ears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is about how bad news travels: it does not come as a rumour, it comes as a man standing in front of you, telling you what your own eyes cannot yet see.
